races.paceDynamic: Knock Off Soxs, Static Charm, and Phantom Gold will ensure a strong gallop from the off, with all three confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead. This pace will stretch the field and create a demanding test of stamina over 2m½f, particularly as they navigate the hurdles at a decent clip. The strong gallop will suit horses with tactical speed who can position prominently without getting involved in the early skirmishes. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those with proven stamina who can quicken off a solid pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Suits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go a strong gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The pace will stretch the field and favour horses like Senator and Tunisya who can sit prominent without engaging early, then quicken when the leaders tire. Hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground against this sustained pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leaders Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If Knock Off Soxs and Static Charm burn each other out
scenarios.body: The strong early pace will set up the race for closers like Alsakib who has the class to finish strongly from off the pace. Late-running horses with stamina will benefit as the pace-setters weaken in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Phantom Gold Dictates Steadier
scenarios.trigger: If Phantom Gold takes them along at a more measured tempo
scenarios.body: The veteran's racecraft allows him to control the pace, making it a sprint finish where his recent winning form counts. This steadier gallop would suit horses who need a tactical race rather than a stamina test.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Benefits Outsiders
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders interfere with each other early
scenarios.body: The disrupted pace creates opportunities for unconsidered horses like the lightly-raced Anxious Moments to slip through. A stop-start gallop would negate the class advantage of the higher-rated runners.

watchPoints.text: Knock Off Soxs and Static Charm could go too fast early and collapse, making the pace unsustainable for even the prominent runners.
Phantom Gold despite his age and low rating has winning form and could surprise if allowed to dictate a steadier tempo.
Senator has excellent form figures on good ground and represents the in-form Jamie Snowden stable who are running at 21% strike-rate.
The lightly-raced pair L'Hybris Is Born and Anxious Moments are hard to assess but could outrun their odds if the pace unfolds to suit.
Alsakib will need the strong early pace to materialize to have any chance from his hold-up position.

races.paceDynamic: Subtle Fortune will lead from the start with no serious challenger for the early pace, creating a sustainable rhythm through the first two miles. The real battle develops behind as six horses (Streamsforth Lad, Black Occ, Sandscape, Atlanta Brave, Peckforton Hills, Kapamazov, El Rojo Grande) all want prominent positions, creating inevitable traffic problems when the race begins in earnest approaching two out. Hold-up horses like Siege Of Acres and Tory Hill will benefit from the early congestion and measured gallop, getting first run while the prominent brigade sorts itself out. This pace shape strongly favours hold-up runners who can avoid the mid-race scramble and produce late finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners get tangled up turning for home and can't get clear runs.
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop and traffic chaos plays perfectly into the hands of horses held up out of trouble. Siege Of Acres and Tory Hill emerge from the pack with devastating late runs while the prominent horses are still fighting for racing room.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Power Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one or two of the prominent horses can secure ideal positions and avoid the congestion.
scenarios.body: El Rojo Grande or Kapamazov use their recent form advantage to thread through the traffic and maintain their challenge. Their superior recent efforts tell as Subtle Fortune's long lead becomes unsustainable.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lone Leader Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Subtle Fortune gets an uncontested lead and the chasing pack neutralizes each other.
scenarios.body: The measured pace suits the front-runner perfectly while the prominent horses spend too much energy fighting amongst themselves. Subtle Fortune kicks clear approaching the last while the field is still sorting itself out behind.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise From Midfield
scenarios.trigger: If a lightly-raced improver finds gaps while the favorites are stuck in traffic.
scenarios.body: Shuile Warrior or another unconsidered runner benefits from the chaos ahead to emerge with a perfectly timed challenge. The pace collapse and traffic problems allow a horse with less recent form to strike at generous odds.

watchPoints.text: Watch for multiple prominent runners getting hampered turning for home when Streamsforth Lad, Atlanta Brave, Kapamazov and El Rojo Grande all need the same racing room.
Monitor if Subtle Fortune gets too comfortable in front as the 18-day break and amateur rider could leave him vulnerable to a late surge.
Check if Siege Of Acres gets the clean passage his hold-up style requires as McCain's string is in good form recently.
Observe whether Tory Hill's 14-day turnaround affects his usual finishing kick despite the weight advantage.
Note if any of the longer-absent runners like Sandscape or Shuile Warrior show market support indicating hidden improvement.

races.paceDynamic: Reckless Spending will lead or race prominently with Park Princess and Pottersville likely to track close behind, creating a trio of prominent runners who should ensure a reasonable gallop without excessive pressure early. The two hold-up horses, Patrick's Wells and Johnny Moonshine, will be anchored at the back in a small field where cover will be limited. With sustainable pace expected and the prominent trio all holding strong credentials, this race shape clearly favours the prominent racers who can secure good positions and avoid traffic problems that could affect the back-runners in such a small field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trio Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is sustainable and the prominent runners maintain their positions without excessive pressure.
scenarios.body: The three prominent runners can dictate terms and kick clear approaching the final flight. The hold-up pair struggle to make up ground from the back of such a small field with limited pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Tells Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes more testing and Reckless Spending's superior rating comes into play.
scenarios.body: Henderson's charge can use his class advantage and Nico de Boinville's tactical nous to outlast his rivals. Park Princess may find the 134 OR of Reckless Spending just too strong despite her recent winning form.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent trio go too fast early and come back to the field approaching the final hurdle.
scenarios.body: Patrick's Wells or Johnny Moonshine can pick up the pieces from their patient rides. The back-runners benefit from the pace collapse and superior finishing kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Upset Special
scenarios.trigger: If going conditions deteriorate or one of the favourites makes a significant jumping error.
scenarios.body: Pottersville could benefit from his lower weight and Rebecca Curtis's good recent form. The race opens up with the market leaders compromised.

watchPoints.text: Watch Reckless Spending's jumping rhythm early - if rusty after 63 days off, it could compromise his position-dependent style.
Monitor the early pace set by the prominent trio - if too conservative, it hands the initiative to Patrick's Wells and Johnny Moonshine.
Observe Park Princess's fluency over the obstacles as any jumping errors could be costly given the small field dynamics.
Check ground conditions throughout the card - any deterioration could impact Reckless Spending's effectiveness given his soft ground concerns.
Watch for tactical positioning after the second flight as the small field means early positioning will largely determine the outcome.

races.paceDynamic: They Want Me is the only confirmed front runner in this 9-runner field and should get an uncontested lead with the next closest prominent runners Shengai Enki, Crack Ops, and I've Madeupmymind likely settling just behind rather than pressuring early. This sets up a sustainable gallop that will allow the pace to build gradually over this 2m3½f trip, with the real action delayed until the final half-mile when the hold-up horses Sutherland, Killycarn, Lejo Du Seuil, and Vinnie O'Neil start making their moves. The lack of early pace pressure heavily favours horses that can travel kindly in the early stages and have a strong finishing kick, making this a race that should strongly suit the hold-up brigade who can time their challenges late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If They Want Me sets reasonable fractions and the prominent horses don't apply early pressure
scenarios.body: The pace builds steadily allowing the back markers to travel comfortably before unleashing late runs when it matters. Sutherland and Killycarn are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical scenario with their proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Duo Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Shengai Enki and Crack Ops track They Want Me closely and kick clear before the hold-up horses can respond
scenarios.body: The race develops into a battle between the three prominent runners with the early positioning proving decisive on this sharp Bangor track. Both have the class and recent form to capitalize if they can steal a march on the closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained Speed Wins
scenarios.trigger: If They Want Me maintains a strong gallop throughout and the field comes to him late rather than early
scenarios.body: The front runner's stamina proves superior over this staying trip as late challengers find themselves chasing shadows. They Want Me's solid recent form suggests he can sustain the effort required.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If They Want Me goes too fast early or the prominent horses engage in a speed duel
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any horse with a turn of foot can capitalize on the early pace casualties. This chaos scenario opens the door for any runner with tactical speed regardless of early position.

watchPoints.text: Vinnie O'Neil's tendency to fade in the finish combined with 113 days off makes him a major pace liability if prominent early
They Want Me's ability to sustain the gallop will determine whether this becomes a tactical race or genuine speed test
Sutherland's early positioning will be crucial as he needs to avoid getting too far back on Bangor's sharp turning track
Crack Ops needs to prove he can handle the step up in class despite his recent confidence-boosting victory
The gap between They Want Me and the prominent horses after the first circuit will indicate how the race will develop

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.label: A

races.paceDynamic: Speed Davis will likely lead from the off with his prominent style, but at 2m7f over hurdles he's unlikely to be pressured early by this field of predominantly hold-up horses. With eight of nine runners showing hold-up tendencies, Speed Davis can dictate a steady gallop through the middle sections before the real race begins approaching the final two flights. This creates a tactical setup where the hold-up horses will need to find racing room and produce sustained finishing efforts from off the pace. The lack of early pace pressure strongly favours patient, strong-finishing hold-up horses who can produce their best work late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Speed Davis maintains control without serious early pressure and sets steady fractions
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade gets the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks, with the pace only quickening from the second-last hurdle. Class horses like Dwight K Schrute and Our Dylan can produce their trademark late surges.

scenarios.body: The tempo lifts earlier than expected, potentially stretching the field and favouring horses with more tactical speed. Those that can travel strongly into the race while still having a kick will benefit over pure hold-up types.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Speed Davis ties up or falls and leaves a tactical vacuum with no clear leader
scenarios.body: The race becomes a scramble with hold-up horses suddenly having to make their own running earlier than ideal. Horses with more versatile styles or those who can quicken from closer positions gain an edge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Speed Davis Stays
scenarios.trigger: If the leader maintains his gallop and the closers fail to produce their usual finishing kick
scenarios.body: The front-runner capitalizes on his uncontested lead and the soft early fractions to keep going when the field tries to close. Any other horse sitting closer to the pace throughout becomes dangerous.

Traffic problems likely in the straight with eight hold-up horses all needing room to mount their challenges simultaneously
First-time headgear on Tiger Orchid and tongue-ties on Golden Glance and Robert d'Ores suggest their connections expect improved efforts
Kintail's positioning will be crucial as the only horse likely to race prominently behind Speed Davis early
Ground conditions remain consistently good across all distances, removing any going-related tactical advantages
